coordinates.source: top-left continuous-edge pixels; x right, y down
coordinates.sample_rect: [x,y,width,height] in source atlas; per-frame PNG is this rectangle after isolating its connected silhouette
coordinates.mirror: SW from SE; NW from NE; design x -> -x. Crop anchor x -> image_width-anchor_x; edge coordinates, no minus one
coordinates.feet: manual visible-foot image envelopes and bottom-edge contact proxies; NOT calibrated 3D footprints; hidden outlines stay null
coordinates.attack_contact: visual staff-tip/muzzle point; not combat range, hitbox or damage timing
coordinates.anchor: manual staging ground reference; not measured skeletal root; frame-to-frame interpolation remains unverified

monk.natural_overhang: staff may extend beyond cell; excluded from monk body bbox

wolf.natural_overhang: tail may extend beyond cell; excluded from wolf body bbox

readiness.static_idle_visual_placement: candidate; four idle views plus mirrors inspected
readiness.monk_SE_move: two distinguishable key poses, no complete smooth cycle
readiness.recommended_integration: isolated prototype only; keep supplied limitations visible; do not label smooth animation
